translations.role.monglish.title: UI/UX Designer
translations.role.monglish.p1: Sole UI/UX designer for an online English academy and its sister brand Edulixa360, serving families across Egypt and the Gulf: research, concept, prototype, stakeholder reviews, developer handoff and QA on staging.
translations.role.monglish.p2: Designed 15+ mobile-first, bilingual (Arabic RTL / English) pages for 2 brands in 2 months, as about 90% of visitors use phones. 3 are live on monglish.co.uk: Kids Courses, Adult Courses and IELTS Courses.
translations.role.monglish.p3: Built two design systems, including a React component library with 100+ documented components, tokens, a responsive grid and motion rules, packaged as Claude Code skills so pages ship with fewer design bugs.
translations.role.monglish.p4: Designed conversion flows: a package configurator with a live summary and price per hour, lead-generation landing pages, and parent-friendly forms with inline validation and duplicate-submit protection.
translations.role.monglish.p5: WCAG 2.2 AA on every page (AAA where possible): the 3 live pages average 92 on Google Lighthouse accessibility (mobile). I build approved designs as Next.js / React pages with Claude Code and hand them off with detailed spec docs.
translations.role.gamp-fe.title: Software Engineer (Front-End, Angular)
translations.role.gamp-fe.p1: Built Angular features for 3 enterprise products (Safesys, Emitum, ControlER) with designers, QA and backend developers in Agile Scrum (GitLab merge requests, CI/CD, Jira).
translations.role.gamp-fe.p2: Cut the Safesys alert counts from about 9 seconds to about 1: the front end was counting alerts by filtering the paginated table, so I asked the backend team for a dedicated count endpoint.
translations.role.gamp-fe.p3: Built a recurring-report scheduler (daily to yearly) with Reactive Forms and Angular Signals, and a shared notification service that keeps unread badges in sync across pages.
translations.role.gamp-fe.p4: Co-built gampfrontend, a shared Angular library in an NX monorepo (with the Safesys app and Keycloak auth), styled with Tailwind CSS and BEM.
translations.role.gamp-fe.p5: Wrote Jest unit tests for components, stores and business logic, reaching over 80% coverage on several features.
translations.role.gamp-ux.title: UI/UX Designer (part-time)
translations.role.gamp-ux.p1: Designed the UI/UX of GapMap, a management system for agricultural markets (stall, partition and parking management), later used by ZRRT to sell nearly 500 market stalls online.
translations.role.gamp-ux.p2: Created user flows, wireframes and high-fidelity Figma screens, and worked with the Angular team on handoff, which led to an internal move into front-end development.

translations.proj.mPage.title: Monglish website redesign
translations.proj.mPage.desc: The sole UI/UX designer for an online English academy serving families across Egypt and the Gulf. Mobile-first, bilingual pages (Arabic RTL and English), since about 90% of visitors are on phones, delivered as Next.js pages. Kids Courses, Adult Courses and IELTS Courses are live. Pick a page:
translations.proj.ePage.title: Edulixa360 pages
translations.proj.ePage.desc: Landing pages for Monglish’s sister brand, an education platform, in Arabic and English. Conversion flows: lead-generation pages and parent-friendly forms with inline validation and duplicate-submit protection.
translations.proj.ds.title: Two design systems
translations.proj.ds.alt: Real components from both systems: the Monglish app login screen and an Edulixa plan card
translations.proj.ds.desc: Monglish DS V2 and Edulixa DS V2, including a React component library with 100+ documented components, tokens, a responsive grid and motion rules, packaged as Claude Code skills so pages ship with fewer design bugs.
translations.proj.gap.alt: GapMap object map screen shown on a laptop
translations.proj.gap.desc: A management system for agricultural markets: stall, partition and parking management, in English and Polish. I designed the user flows, wireframes and high-fidelity Figma screens. ZRRT later used it to sell nearly 500 market stalls online.
translations.proj.safesys.alt: Safesys Pomiary measurement dashboard with a live line chart, shown on a laptop
translations.proj.safesys.desc: A measurement dashboard (pomiary is Polish for measurements) that syncs the selected assets with the map, with consumption charts and a page-scoped Signals store that reduced API requests. Alert counts went from about 9s to 1s once they came from a dedicated endpoint instead of a front-end table filter.
translations.proj.gamp.desc: A shared Angular library I co-built in an NX monorepo with the Safesys app and Keycloak auth: reusable components, from buttons to shared services, styled with Tailwind CSS and BEM, imported by projects instead of rebuilt.
translations.proj.emitum.desc: Self-service registration, account and privacy flows for online shareholder meetings, with a progress bar instead of numbered steps.
translations.proj.controler.desc: Drag-and-drop scheduling for 50+ resources, with role-based access and live notifications.
